title: Commercial Property Legal Assistant
description:
Commercial Property Legal Assistant

Portsmouth

A fantastic opportunity has arisen for a Commercial Property Legal Assistant to join an established law firm in Portsmouth. Working as part of a busy and friendly Property team, you will provide key support to Fee Earners across a varied commercial property caseload.

Working closely with Fee Earners, you will provide day-to-day legal and administrative support across a varied portfolio of commercial property matters.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Supporting Fee Earners with a varied commercial property caseload.
- Opening new files and matters on the firm's Case Management system.
- Preparing client care letters.
- Drafting correspondence, documents and precedents on behalf of Fee Earners.
- Submitting property searches and assisting with reports on search results and title documentation.
- Preparing and submitting Land Registry applications.
- Assisting with completions and post-completion formalities.
- Liaising with clients, solicitors and other relevant parties to ensure matters progress smoothly and Fee Earners are kept up to date.
- Audio typing from digital dictation.
- Managing diaries and arranging client and departmental meetings using Outlook.
- Providing general administrative and legal support to the Property team as required.

You will ideally have:
- At least 1 year's legal secretarial or legal assistant experience within Property.
- Experience supporting commercial property matters.
- Strong legal administration and secretarial skills.
- Experience with audio typing and digital dictation systems.
- Previous experience using a Case Management system.

What they offer:
- Monday - Friday 9am - 5pm and in the office.
- Salary depending on experience - £25,000 +
- Competitive holiday plus bank holiday.
- Pension scheme.

title: Legal Assistant
description:
Legal Assistant

Are you an experienced Legal Assistant looking to develop your career within a well-established and supportive Private Client team?

We are seeking a highly organised and proactive Legal Assistant to join our client based in Emsworth, supporting their specialist Wills, Trusts & Probate department. This is an excellent opportunity to join a busy and respected team, playing a key role in assisting clients with sensitive and important matters.

This position would suit a professional individual who thrives in a fast-paced legal environment, has exceptional attention to detail, and enjoys delivering outstanding client service.

The Role

Working closely with fee earners and solicitors within the Private Client department, you will provide comprehensive administrative and secretarial support to ensure matters progress efficiently and clients receive an exceptional level of service.

Key Responsibilities
- Opening and setting up new client files in accordance with compliance procedures.
- Providing full administrative and secretarial support to the Wills, Trusts & Probate team.
- Preparing correspondence, legal documents, forms, and court paperwork accurately and efficiently.
- Managing diaries, appointments, meetings, and client communications.
- Assisting with probate and estate administration matters, including liaising with executors, beneficiaries, and third-party organisations.
- Chasing outstanding documentation and information from clients and external bodies, including HMRC, the Office of the Public Guardian, financial institutions, and other relevant organisations.
- Processing incoming and outgoing post, ensuring all correspondence is accurately recorded and actioned.
- Updating and maintaining client records through the firm's case management system.
- Supporting fee earners with file management from instruction through to completion and closure.
- Assisting with the preparation of Lasting Powers of Attorney, Wills, and Probate applications.
- Always ensuring confidentiality and compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.
- Undertaking general office and administrative duties as required.

About You
- Previous experience working as a Legal Assistant, Legal Secretary or Administrator within a Private Client department.
- Experience supporting matters relating to Wills, Probate, Estate Administration, Trusts, or Powers of Attorney.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- A professional, empathetic, and client-focused approach.
- Experience using case management systems and Microsoft Office packages.
- The ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team.
- A proactive attitude with a willingness to learn and develop.

Working hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00am-17:00pm.

Salary: 28k-32k (DOE)

Brook Street NMR is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy.

title: Legal Assistant
description:
Chalk Hill Group are supporting a regional law firm with an excellent reputation with their recruitment of a Legal Assistant to join their Private Client team in the New Forest.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a client-focused legal environment and wants to play an important role in supporting fee earners across a varied caseload.

The role

You'll provide high-quality administrative and procedural support to Partners and Associates, helping matters progress efficiently while maintaining a professional, compassionate and responsive service to clients.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Acting as a professional and welcoming first point of contact for clients
- Supporting client appointments, onboarding and ID checks
- Preparing and maintaining accurate files, correspondence and document packs
- Managing file opening/closing procedures and tracking deadlines
- Assisting with probate, trust and estate administration documentation
- Producing documents from digital dictation and audio typing
- Managing diaries, appointments and meetings
- Supporting billing and general administrative processes
- Liaising with clients, financial institutions, professional advisers and other third parties
- Providing wider team support during busy periods

About you
- Previous experience working in a law firm
- Private Client, Wills, Trusts or Probate experience is desirable
- Strong typing, audio typing and document production skills
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail
- Confident use of Microsoft Office and case management systems
- The ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

What's on offer
- Competitive salary, dependent on experience
- 34 days' holiday including Bank Holidays
- Free Parking
- Hybrid / Flexible working
- Health Cash Plan
- Life Insurance
- Staff Discount Platform
- Supportive, collaborative and friendly working environment

Chalk Hill Group is a Recruitment Agency. By applying for this role, you are authorising us as a Recruitment Agency to contact you and to provide services and information relating to job hunting activities. Please see our Privacy Policy on our website.

title: Legal Assistant - Commercial Property
company: Harwood Recruitment Solutions Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
I'm currently recruiting for a Legal Assistant to join the Commercial Property team within a well established Law firm in Portsmouth. This is a great opportunity to become part of an experienced team, working closely with the Fee Earners and getting involved in a varied range of commercial property matters. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include opening new files, carrying out compliance checks, preparing correspondence and legal documents, speaking with clients and assisting with post-completion work.

I'm looking for someone with previous office or administration experience who enjoys working with others and providing a high level of client care. Experience in a law firm, conveyancing or commercial property would be ideal, but not essential. If you're organised, have a keen eye for detail and are looking for a role where you can learn, develop and become a valued part of the team, I'd love to hear from you.

Day to day duties will include -
- Open new files, deal with all compliance requirements and client care due diligence in the process, and subsequently undertake such work on the file as may be directed by the Fee Earner such as carrying out searches and legal research.
- Accurately draft letters and correspondence, type up amendments, prepare initial draft of legal documents and prepare engrossments. All typing to be spell checked and proof read prior to passing to the Fee Earner.
- Ensure any post is ready in time for Reception to arrange for this to be franked and placed in the post bag.
- Fully utilise the Case Management system, file documents and all correspondence and generally keep the system up to date and in an organised manner. The paper file is to be kept to a similar standard.
- Filing should be undertaken at the request of your Fee Earner.
- Answer the telephone promptly in a professional manner, being polite and helpful at all times. The aim to assist with calls of a general nature on your Fee Earner's files, giving updates on matters where necessary, or taking messages where this is not possible.
- Attend clients on behalf of your Fee Earner in reception and on the telephone for routine matters such as making appointments/collecting documents/paying bills etc or as directed by the Fee Earner.
- Assist your Fee Earner with the preparation of bills and completion statements and ensure that they have been sent to the appropriate external and internal parties.
- Deal with post-completion elements on the files including preparing and submitting Land Registry applications as well as Stamp Duty Land Tax forms and deal with any subsequent requisitions/enquiries.

This is a full time, office based role - working 9am - 5pm, Monday to Friday, offering competitive salary, excellent benefits and full training and support - please apply today!

title: Private Client Legal Assistant / Paralegal
description:
Private Client Legal Assistant / Paralegal

Petersfield

A fantastic opportunity has arisen for a Private Client Legal Assistant / Paralegal to join a successful and growing legal team in Petersfield. This role would suit an experienced legal support professional with a genuine interest in Private Client work, looking to build on their existing experience within a supportive and established team.

You will provide essential support across a varied caseload, working closely with experienced solicitors. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking for a long-term career within Private Client law.

Key Responsibilities:
- Providing day-to-day legal and administrative support to the Private Client team.
- Assisting with matters relating to Wills, Probate, Estate Administration, Trusts and Lasting Powers of Attorney.
- Preparing and amending legal documents and correspondence.
- Opening, maintaining and closing client files.
- Liaising with clients and other relevant parties.
- Preparing documents for meetings and assisting with the preparation of Wills and other private client documentation.
- Managing diaries, arranging appointments and assisting with client meetings.
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring files are kept up to date.
- Handling confidential and sensitive client information appropriately.
- Supporting the wider Private Client team with general administrative duties as required.

About You:
- The successful candidate will ideally have previous experience within a Private Client legal environment, although applications from candidates with broader legal support experience will also be considered.
- Previous experience as a Legal Assistant, Legal Secretary, Paralegal or similar within a law firm.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational and time-management abilities.
- A professional and personable approach when dealing with clients.
- Good IT skills and confidence using Microsoft Office and legal case management systems.
- The ability to work independently while also contributing effectively to a wider team.

What's on Offer:
- Salary depending on experience £25,000 - £28,000.
- Monday - Friday 9am - 5pm.
- Company pension.
- Health & wellbeing programme.
